Static Cryptographic Analysis Scope & Boundaries

  • Local AST Scope: Analysis inspects syntax expressions, compile-time constants, final local variables, and linear assignments within parsed compilation units.
  • No Dynamic Environment Resolution: Cryptographic algorithms configured via runtime configuration files (e.g. application.properties), remote service calls, or environment variables remain marked as UNKNOWN.
  • Absence of Runtime TLS Interception: TLS protocol versions reflect requested configurations (e.g. SSLContext.getInstance("TLSv1.3")) rather than actively negotiated socket sessions.
  • Non-Security Hashes: Algorithms such as MD5 or SHA-1 used exclusively for cache keys or file checksums trigger review findings; manual inspection should verify non-security usage.
  • Third-Party Cryptographic Wrappers: Non-JCA wrapper libraries (Bouncy Castle native APIs, Apache Commons Crypto) are tracked when binding to JCA providers.
